### Qantas To Cut 850 Jobs, Shift Some Corporate Roles To India |  WION Dispatch

Australian airline Qantas has announced plans to cut around 850 jobs as part of a major restructuring drive and a multi-year partnership with technology consultancy Accenture. The move will affect corporate functions including finance, procurement, human resources and marketing. Some roles will be outsourced to Accenture teams, primarily in India, while the airline looks to modernise its systems and expand the use of artificial intelligence. The first changes are expected to take effect by mid-2027.

### LIVE: Pete Hegseth Breaks 180-Day Silence As Impeachment Threat Looms Over Pentagon Chief | US News

US Secretary Of War Pete Hegseth is facing a historic impeachment threat as he prepares to hold his first news conference in more than 180 days. Republican Representative Thomas Massie has introduced a resolution accusing Hegseth of impeachable conduct, focusing largely on the Iran war and also citing U.S. military actions in Yemen and Venezuela. Only two US Cabinet secretaries have ever been impeached: William Belknap in 1876 and Alejandro Mayorkas in 2024.
